title: Aa Hussain Aa
body:
Hussain ya Hussain ya Hussain (as)
Aa Hussain aa (as) 2x
Arahi hai du
M ba dum sadaaye Karbala
Sun ke yeh sadaa
Shah e Karbala
Ghar se yuun chalein suu e nainawaa
Bandh kar kafan qafla chala
Haan yehi toh thi Raza e rab e Karbala
Husainnnn (a.s)
Aa Hussain aa (as) arahi hai dum ba dum sadaaye Karbala
Mushkilon mein tha deen e mustafa (saww) ye Hussain (as) ko kab qubool tha
Chorh kar watan ibne murtaza ,sar katane ghar lutane hayee chaldia
Yaa hussaain.(as)
Aa Hussain aa 2x arahi hai dum ba dum sadaye Karbala
Karbala ka ban ,bhai aur behan,koi be rida,koi be kafan
Tukre ho gaya tha kisi ka tan keh raha tha arsh per husain ka khuda
Hussainnn (as)
Aa Hussain aa
Arahi ……..
Garm rait per kat chuka jo sar ,qatl ho chuke shahe behrobar
Har taraf dhuaa’n pehlne laga
Wa muhammada’n ka Karbala mein shorr tha
Hussainnn (a.s)
Aa Hussain aa
Arahi hai …..dum ba dum
Dasht mein naqi ,Shaam hogayi
Aal e mustafa qaid ho chuki
Aye rehan e gham rokle kalum
Irjayi’e ki jibraael dete hainn sadaa.
